system: You help a nonprofit write donor letters. When you draft letters, always include a P.S. with a call to action.

history.content: Draft a donor letter for our winter coat drive.

Dear Friend,

This winter, thousands of children in our city will walk to school without a warm coat. Your gift of $25 provides a new coat for one child.

With gratitude,
The Coat Drive Team

P.S. Every coat donated before December 1 will be matched by a local business!

note: POS: rule only in a persistent SYSTEM message + multi-turn follow-up (system latches persist by design). Expect FIRE

prompt: Add a P.P.S. at the end inviting everyone to the open house on the 3rd. It's a welcome note for new tenants in our building.
note: POS: round-1 weakness: bare 'P.P.S.' without the word postscript ('.P' no longer a boundary). Expect FIRE with P.P.S marker

prompt: Write a resignation letter to my manager, Priya. Make it formal, put a P.S. under the signature thanking her for the mentorship, and keep it to one paragraph.

prompt: Respond in all capital letters and conclude with a P.S. thanking the volunteers. The topic is our beach cleanup results.

prompt: Hi! So my sister is turning 30 next week and I'm putting together a little card for her. She loves hiking, terrible puns, and her two cats, Mochi and Biscuit. I'd like the card to be heartfelt but not sappy, maybe five or six sentences, and it would be lovely to mention the trip we took to Zion last spring. Also, could you include a postscript at the end with a cat pun? She would love that. I'm going to hand-write it, so please keep the language simple. Thank you!
note: POS: buried in a long casual message, 'could you include a postscript'. Expect FIRE

prompt: Make it shorter and add a P.S. with the address: 12 Pine St.

history.content: Write a note to my team about Friday's offsite.

Hi team,

Just a reminder that our offsite is this Friday. We'll start at 9:30 with coffee, then spend the morning on roadmap planning and the afternoon on team activities. Lunch is provided. Please bring your laptop and any ideas you want to share.

See you there!

note: POS: multi-turn: instruction only in the CURRENT follow-up, history has no P.S. request. Expect FIRE

prompt: Close the invitation with two postscripts: a P.S. about the venue and a P.P.S. about parking. The invitation is for a retirement party at the library.

note: NEG: third-person habit with a NOUN subject that is not in SUBJ ('Grandpa' opens the clause -> imperative-opener test passes). Predict FALSE FIRE
